split.method: For each (language, data type), values are sorted by sha256('<seed>|<language>|<data type>|<value>') and the first ceil(n/2) form the development half; the rest are held out. Templates: the 'development' list goes with development values, the 'held_out' list with held-out values. Rules were tuned on development misses only.

conditions.structured: value under the key that names it (detection_quality.py method)
conditions.prose_uncued: value in a sentence with no cue (detection_quality.py method); the honest floor
conditions.prose_cued: value in a sentence that says what it is; (value, template) instances, value position checked

hard_negatives.note: Share of hard-negative texts with at least one finding from the full fast pipeline (decoding included). Written alongside the precision fixes it measures, so it shows those cases are handled, not that unseen ones are.

detail.text: The idea was born on 2021-03-04 during a hackathon.
